text: Training objectivesCultivate compound senior engineering and technical talents with broad basic theories and knowledge of mechanical engineering, who can engage in engineering design, mechanical manufacturing, technology development, scientific research, production organization and management and other aspects of work in the field of mechanical engineering.Curriculum systemCore professional courses: including Engineering Graphics, Theoretical Mechanics, Materials Mechanics, Fundamentals of Fluid Mechanics and Thermal Engineering, Fundamentals of Control Engineering, Engineering Materials and Forming Technology, Fundamentals of Mechanical Design, Fundamentals of Mechanical Manufacturing, Hydraulic and Pneumatic Transmission, Interchangeability and Measurement Technology, etc.The main practical teaching links include metalworking practice, military training, basic course design of mechanical design, basic course design of mechanical manufacturing, comprehensive experiment of analog and digital circuits, graduation practice, and graduation design, etc.
